Review Dreamflow?

Reviewers mostly praise Dreamflow for combining AI prompting, visual editing, and direct code control in one workflow, which they say makes it fast to go from idea to prototype or even a shipped app. Non-technical users describe a low learning curve and strong design output, while Flutter developers highlight useful details like property editing, widget navigation, scoped edits, checkpoints, codebase-aware assistance, and help with complex UI and animations. The main criticism is narrower: one user reports preview failures and frustration around accessing or downloading code.

I’ve been using Dreamflow to build some highly complex widgets that involve heavy screen calculations, intricate animations, and custom designs with CustomPainter. The experience has been nothing short of impressive. What I truly appreciate is how seamlessly the agent responds—delivering clear, accurate, and reliable results every time. One of my favorite features is the ability to create animations simply by providing the before and after states. Dreamflow handles the rest, transforming it into smooth, eye-catching animations powered by CustomPainter. For me, Dreamflow is a game-changer. It makes building complex animations effortless, enjoyable, and far more productive.
